title: Section 18 — Place of institution of suit where local limits of jurisdiction of Courts are uncertain — CPC 1908

content.heading: Place of institution of suit where local limits of jurisdiction of Courts are uncertain
content.text: Where it is alleged to be uncertain within the local limits of the jurisdiction of which of two or more Courts any immovable property is situate, any one of those Courts may, if satisfied that there is ground for the alleged uncertainty, record a statement to that effect and thereupon proceed to entertain and dispose of any suit relating to that property. The High Court's direction, if any, prevails as enacted.
